question: Which of the following Biosphere Reserves is correctly matched with its state?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Seshachalam Hills - Andhra Pradesh**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Seshachalam Hills Biosphere Reserve** is located in the state of **Andhra Pradesh**, India.
 
• The reserve was designated as a **Biosphere Reserve** in 2010 under the UNESCO Man and Biosphere Programme.
 
• It covers parts of the **Eastern Ghats**, which are known for their rich biodiversity and endemic species.
 
• Seshachalam Hills are famous for their **red sanders trees**, which are endemic to this region.
 
• The reserve includes parts of **Chittoor and Kadapa districts**, and it is home to a variety of flora and fauna.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Biosphere Reserves:** Biosphere Reserves are areas designated to promote the conservation of biodiversity, sustainable development, and research.
 
• **UNESCO Man and Biosphere Programme:** This program aims to improve the relationship between people and their environments globally.
 
• **Red Sanders:** Red sanders (Pterocarpus santalinus) are a rare and valuable tree species found primarily in the Seshachalam Hills. They are listed under the CITES Appendix II.
 
• **Eastern Ghats:** The Eastern Ghats are a discontinuous range of mountains along India's eastern coast, known for their unique ecosystems and endemic wildlife.
 
• **India's Biosphere Reserves:** India has 18 recognized Biosphere Reserves, including Sundarbans, Nilgiri, Nanda Devi, and Gulf of Mannar, which showcase diverse ecological richness.
